scheme_name: Encouragement Scheme for Taking Admission in Science and Contemporary Subjects
other_conditions: Must be a native of Madhya Pradesh
Must have passed Class 10 and be enrolled in Class 11 Science stream
Must have passed Class 12 and be enrolled in a B.Sc. program in Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics, or Biology
benefits_summary: ST students receive a scholarship of ₹2,000 per month for Class 11 Science enrollment and ₹3,000 per month for B.Sc. enrollment in Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics, or Biology.
